title: Effective descent glues along compatible invariant opens
statement: Let p:X\to Y be a singleton fpqc covering of schemes [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering] and let D be a transport descent datum [def-pd-descent-datum] on V\to X. Let (U_i)_{i\in I} be an open covering of V [def-weil-open-immersion]. For each i suppose a descent datum E_i on U_i\to X is given, and the inclusion U_i\to V intertwines its transport with D for every test scheme and pair of maps to X with equal image in Y. If each E_i is effective, then D is effective. No affine or finite morphism hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Descent, Lemma 35.35.13, Tag 0AP4, proof; transport formulation and general singleton fpqc covering

proof.text: Select one covering open for every point of V. This yields a point-indexed subcover in the scheme universe, including the empty scheme case. For this subcover select explicit effective witnesses W_i,q_i, their cartesian squares and transport-invariance proofs from the hypotheses.
Apply the geometric chart-construction lemma to these explicit witnesses, obtaining W_0 over Y, q_0, and a jointly covering family of open chart embeddings j_i with cartesian chart squares.

Form the open cover of W_0 given by j_i. Each chart square identifies U_i with the pullback of q_0 along j_i. Transport the original cartesian square of q_i along that identification. Mathlib Scheme.isPullback_of_openCover then gives IsPullback q_0 V.hom W_0.hom p.

For any test-scheme point a over f_1, choose around each source point the inverse image A of one U_i containing its image. The restriction b:A to U_i is morphismRestrict. Naturality of D identifies its restricted transport with the transport of b followed by inclusion, using the given compatibility. The chart-square equation changes inclusion followed by q_0 to q_i followed by j_i. Transport invariance of q_i proves the desired equality on A. Scheme.hom_ext_of_forall proves the global equality. Package this equality and the global cartesian square as D.IsEffective.

proof_origin.place: Descent, Tag 0AP4; geometric charts split into lem-pd-glued-effective-model-charts, with global cartesianness and transport invariance proved in Lean

lean.statement: theorem isEffective_of_effective_open_cover {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {p : X ⟶ Y} (hp : Presieve.singleton p ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage Y) {V : Over X} (D : Over.DescentDatum p V) {I : Type v} (U : I → V.left.Opens) (hcover : ∀ x : V.left, ∃ i, x ∈ U i) (E : ∀ i, Over.DescentDatum p (Over.mk ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom))) (hcompat : ∀ (i : I) {T : Scheme.{u}} (f₁ f₂ : T ⟶ X) (h : f₁ ≫ p = f₂ ≫ p) (a : Over.mk f₁ ⟶ Over.mk ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom)), ((E i).transport f₁ f₂ h a).left ≫ (U i).ι = (D.transport f₁ f₂ h (Over.homMk (a.left ≫ (U i).ι) (by simpa only [Over.mk_hom, Category.assoc] using Over.w a))).left) (heffective : ∀ i, (E i).IsEffective) : D.IsEffective
